sentences.text: Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Dubey,Sachin Kumar Upadhyay Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 112 of 2015, under Section 498A, 304B of IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meja, District Allahabad(Prayagraj) with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first bail application of the applicant was rejected by order dated 03.04.2017 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.10049 of 2017.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.10049 of 2017
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that the statement of PW-1 was recorded on 02.08.2017 thereafter this witness did not turn up for examination before the court.
Further it is submitted that the trial of the case is under progress, vide supplementary affidavit, the order sheet of the trial court is also filed.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 10.06.2015. having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121067663/
1 and argued that on 02.08.2017 PW-1 was present in the court but no cross-examination was done on behalf of the applicant for want of his counsel and the opportunity to cross-examine the witness has been closed by the court concerned.
Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, period of incarceration and the fact that only one witness has been recorded so far, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicantDinesh Kumar in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2). The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

(5) The applicant will not seek any adjournment on the date of evidence when the witness is present and also on the date when his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
is to be recorded.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 17.1.2023 VK Bharteey  Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121067663/
